title: Raku Workshop
bring: 5-6 bisqued pieces (large-mug or small vase size preferred), closed-toed shoes, long hair tied back
cost_text: $40 firing fee includes glazes, propane, and firing of 5 pieces
commitment: Single day event with two one-hour firings, typically ending around noon
summary: Learn raku firing, a 16th-century fast-firing technique with atmospheric reduction. Glaze your bisque pieces and manage reduction chambers. Cost is $40 per 5 pieces fired.
how_to_join: Contact the studio by phone (916) 966-2453 or email information@acaistudios.com to inquire about upcoming workshop dates.
source_quote: Raku Workshop Registration - Unravel the secrets of Raku, a 16th-century fast-firing technique.
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes a raku firing event where potters glaze pieces and manage reduction chambers.
evidence_quote: Unravel the secrets of Raku, a 16th-century fast-firing technique. In the workshop, you'll learn what makes this low-fire process so unique through the manipulation of the atmosphere around the clay piece.
